provenance.note: Optical-centre offset and FOV limits were measured from the Livox STEP models; every other field is quoted from the manual's Specifications table (p. 20) or the Dimensions appendix (p. 19).

fov.manual_quote: FOV: Horizontal: 360 deg, Vertical: -7 deg ~ 52 deg
fov.step_note: Shell vertices in mid-360-fov-asm.stp span -7.0 to +54.0 deg about the STEP origin; the extra 2 deg at the top edge is cap geometry, so the manual's +52 is used as the working limit.

geometry.optical_centre_note: mid-360-asm.stp places the device between y=-25.92 mm and y=+34.18 mm about the STEP origin (60.10 mm total, matching the 60.0 mm datasheet height). The FOV shell in mid-360-fov-asm.stp is centred on that same origin, so the origin is the optical centre and it sits 25.92 mm above the bottom mounting face.
geometry.mount_pattern: 4 x M3, 5 mm deep, on a 48.0 x 36.0 mm rectangle in the bottom face; two 3.0 mm locating holes

ranging.range_note: Detection range is quoted at 100 klx. Effective range varies inside the FOV: longest near the lower (-7 deg) edge, shortest near the upper edge.

sampling.fov_coverage_note: Coverage grows with integration time: about a 32-line mechanical lidar at 0.1 s, about 70 percent of the FOV at 0.5 s.

installation_constraints.quote: If mounting the Mid-360 upside down, allow a space of no less than 0.5 m between the mounting surface and the ground.
installation_constraints.hexapod_impact: The deck sits at 0.185-0.205 m. Every inverted mount on this robot violates this requirement unless the sensor is carried on a mast of at least 0.5 m.

installation_constraints.quote: The Mid-360 cannot bear any extra payload. Otherwise, the reliability of the product cannot be guaranteed.
When mounting the Mid-360, allow a space of at least 10 mm around the device to prevent poor airflow which can affect heat dissipation.

It is recommended to mount the Mid-360 on a flat metal surface. The metal base plate should have a thickness of no less than 3 mm, and an area of no less than 10000 mm2 on the metal plate should be exposed to the air for heat dissipation.
installation_constraints.hexapod_impact: 10000 mm2 is a 100 x 100 mm plate, larger than the 65 x 65 mm sensor footprint and larger than any mast cap. Budget deck area for it.

installation_constraints.quote: When mounting the Mid-360, the FOV must not be blocked by any object, including glass.
